sources: Rational Farewell. rmxlinux Json/SkillData/sk_wpn_pistol_0004 (weapon skill 3, SkillPatchTable: dmg_up, atk_up, duration): cardAttributeModifier attr 32 (Battle Skill DMG) formulaItem 5 +dmg_up (stat panel, with skills 1 and 2: Strength, Heat DMG); passiveEventActions abilityEvent 127 (the wielder applies an Arts Burst) and abilityEvent 206 (the wielder applies a buff) + CheckBuffIdInContext tag -1110095722 (Burning = Combustion), both with CheckOriginSkillType [6] (from a combo skill) -> CreateBuff buff_wpn_pistol_0004_atk_up on the wielder (attr 2 formulaItem 6 +atk_up, duration `duration`, stackingType 2 max 1: a new one replaces the old). "When the wielder's combo skill applies Arts Burst or Combusted, the wielder gains ATK +{atk_up} for {duration}s. Effects of the same name cannot stack." buff_wpn_pistol_0004_up is named by nothing (orphan). Batch-3 report docs/kit-batches/batch-3/chr_0006_wolfgd.md rows W1-W2.

triggers.note: abilityEvent 127 from a combo. The engine's burst event is when the burst lands (a second after its infliction, A5); before the burst's damage, as Umbra's trigger on the same event.

abilityEvent 206 + Burning tag from a combo: Combustion formed (or forced) by the wielder's combo. Before the combo hit's damage, as the data's SpellInfliction precedes its DamageAction (in-game test 51's question).
